data: Is the percentage of the encoder higher than that of the decoder?

The pie chart shows three segments representing the percentage contributions of the encoder, decoder, and others. The encoder segment is blue and represents 35%, while the decoder segment is red and represents 54%. The percentage of the encoder is clearly lower than that of the decoder. Therefore, the answer is no, the percentage of the encoder is not higher than that of the decoder.
